ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (light gray/white) to 30% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary dark contiguous geometric region is centered at the peduncle junction, extending symmetrically into the proximal regions of both lobes. Secondary small, high-contrast dark punctate clusters are scattered across the predominantly light-colored distal lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The medial trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude undulations, transitioning to high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally convex curve from the notch to the tips, with the tips themselves appearing slightly upturned.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are detected at the extreme distal margins of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, dark linear pixel disruptions are visible: one prominent diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe and a curved mark on the inner-right lobe near the central pigmentation boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of ectoparasitic fouling (barnacles) on the distal tips and multiple thin, dark linear scars on the ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The transition boundary of the central dark pigmentation zone is highly irregular and 'feathered' against the lighter background.
